candidates.title: Breaking the 1.58-bit Barrier for Ternary LLMs
candidates.reason: 29 ternary LLMのzero densityを利用するBITCOS layoutとAVX/Xe2 unpackingを実装し、1.485 bit/weight、kernel最大1.28倍、end-to-end decode最大1.27倍を実測。

candidates.title: HoliBench: A Cross-Platform Benchmarking and Deployment Toolkit for Foundation Models in CPS-IoT Applications
candidates.reason: 20 model×7 device×3 quantization×8 backendをaccuracy/latency/energyで横断測定するdeployment toolkit。低bit hardware supportの有無でlatency効果が変わる点も定量化。

candidates.title: Why Does Post-Training Quantization Work?
candidates.reason: pretrained LLMで量子化errorが層間で部分相殺されLM-head geometryがhigh-rank tokenを保護する機構を実証し、PTQ robustnessの設計根拠を与える。

candidates.title: OBC-Prune: Outcome-Based Calibration for Large Reasoning Model Pruning
candidates.reason: reasoning tokenのcausal importanceでSparseGPT/Wanda/ALPSのcalibration activationを再重み付けし40–50% sparsityでreasoning性能を改善。推論overhead削減系の高品質候補。

candidates.title: Accuracy is Not Enough: A Divergence-Based Approach to Evaluate Fidelity Loss in Quantized LLMs
candidates.reason: 5 architecture・4 reasoning benchmark・120 runでBF16からQ2_Kまでfull-vocabulary divergenceを測定し、llama.cpp Q4_Kが同程度memoryのQ4_0より低driftとなる傾向を示す。
